title: JamesMobs
description: Jamesmobs is a mod that adds plenty of mobs to your world. I plan on updating this over time, adding more and more mobs!
body:
JamesMobs
Vanilla-Friendly Mobs
JamesMobs adds new creatures to Minecraft that feel like they’ve always belonged.

Features
🐘 Elephant
The first addition to the mod is a carefully designed mob that blends seamlessly into the world.

Naturally spawning mob
Balanced for survival gameplay
Includes unique advancements to guide progression
New Resources
Elephant Meat
Ivory
Ivory Totems
Craft powerful Ivory Totems that grant useful effects:

Totem of Strength
Totem of Speed
Totem of Water Breathing
 
Easy to Learn
No complicated systems.

All features are introduced through in-game advancements, so you can learn everything just by playing.

Compatibility
Loader: Fabric
Minecraft Version: 1.21.8
Multiplayer: Supported
Future Updates
More mobs and features are planned, if you want to follow along, subscribe to JamesMinecraft on YouTube.

Final Notes
If you find any bug or weird thing, let me know so I can try to fix it. This was my first mod, so be nice ok Bye.
